# Halberd — the Nouns (what the system is made of)

Every thing in the Halberd enterprise, from the whole enterprise (top)
down to its smallest modeled parts, 6 levels deep. Each item is made of the items indented beneath it;
no item has fewer than 2 or more than 9 parts. ↑ marks an item already broken down earlier in the tree.
